secrets.name: Under the Bed
secrets.text: Under the bed, where the blanket hangs down, there is a way into the floor, and a den: cushions, a torch still on, drawings of monsters pinned up, and a book on how to be brave. Somebody small was here a moment ago, hiding from you.

meta.label: The Nursery
meta.blurb: A child's bedroom, but the child it was built for is enormous: you only come up to the top of the mattress. It is nearly bedtime. It is always nearly bedtime.
